basic_info.description: An SF home that does not come around often. Perfect pied--terre to pass down through generations, or serve as an amazing starter HOME for those who cannot afford a single family in Laurel Village/Presidio Heights, but still want the benefits of one! TOP FLOOR sanctuary detached on 3 sides, boasting nearly 1700sqft of generous proportions. Chef's Dream Kitchen w/a View: No expense was spared on this entertainer's space. Sprawling kitchen features top-of-the-line appliances + custom, optimized cabinetry, designed for hosting unforgettable gatherings. A View That Never Ends: Ever changing masterpiece from the wrap-around windows- from sunsets over Ocean Beach to the twinkling towers of the GG Bridge. Quiet back BRs w/ custom closets do not share a wall for addt'l privacy, one en-suite. Peaceful backyard space. Independent garage w/ EV charger, 2nd car in driveway. Secured storage, private w/d. Quiet tree lined street ends into Laurel Village- very few cars ever drive by. Steps from vibrant energy + convenience of Laurel Village/Sacramento Street's renowned fine dining, high-design boutiques, artisan coffee + gourmet grocers. Get out on Presidio's trails or sport courts or enjoy views from your massive windows on rainy days + cozy up to the f/p. Your lifestyle is instantly upgraded.
